montage.intro.en: Joins a hook, two to four strong scenes and a cliff from this title's ad clips into one vertical ad of up to 60 seconds: hard cuts in story order, the sound brought to one loudness, nothing added to the picture. Nothing after the spoiler line is used. The ad appears in Clips as “Ad · 60 s”, to download or to use in Launch like any clip.
montage.intro.zh: 从这部剧集的广告切片中取一个开场钩子、两到四个高能场景和一个悬念结尾，按剧情顺序硬切，拼成一条不超过 60 秒的竖版广告：统一响度，画面上不加任何内容，剧透线之后的内容不会用到。成片会出现在“切片”中，标为“广告 · 60 秒”，可以下载，也可以像其他切片一样在“投放”中使用。

montage.none.hint.en: Made from this title's existing ad clips; nothing is spent.
montage.none.hint.zh: 用这部剧集已有的广告切片拼成，不产生费用。

montage.building.hint.en: Joining {n} pieces into one file ({length}): usually a minute or two. This part of the page refreshes on its own.
montage.building.hint.zh: 正在把 {n} 段拼成一个文件（{length}），通常需要一两分钟，这里会自动刷新。

montage.exists.en: This ad is already built from the current clips; it is the first one below.
montage.exists.zh: 当前切片已经生成过这条广告，就是下方第一条。

montage.refused.no_clips.en: This title has no ad clips yet. Cut clips on its episodes first, then build the 60-second ad.
montage.refused.no_clips.zh: 这部剧集还没有广告切片。先为分集切片，再生成 60 秒广告。

montage.refused.too_few.en: A 60-second ad needs a hook, at least two scenes and a cliff: four separate moments from before the spoiler line. Usable clips so far: {n}. Cut clips on more of its early episodes, then try again.
montage.refused.too_few.zh: 60 秒广告需要一个开场钩子、至少两个场景和一个悬念结尾，也就是剧透线之前四段互不相连的内容。目前可用切片：{n} 条。先为更多靠前的分集切片，再试一次。

montage.cannotBuild.en: You can watch and download these ads; building one needs edit rights on this title.
montage.cannotBuild.zh: 你可以观看和下载这些广告；生成需要这部剧集的编辑权限。

montage.failed.render_failed.en: The ad could not be joined from its clips. Press Build again; if it fails twice, tell Pulsar staff.
montage.failed.render_failed.zh: 没能把切片拼成广告。再点一次生成；如果连续两次失败，请告诉 Pulsar 工作人员。

montage.failed.stopped.en: The build stopped before it finished. Press Build again.
montage.failed.stopped.zh: 生成在完成前中断了。再点一次生成。
